answer: Rotating task-window challenge. Each identity draws a random work window from a shared clock; the server issues a one-time lantern code valid only inside that window, and every submission must carry it. Duplicating an identity means running two windows at once, which forces conflicting replies to the same challenge and tags the copy. Across the tide of submissions, mismatches surface as a mesa of failed checks. Attacker cost: continuous parallel compute plus forfeited rewards per detected clone.
